column1: # What the differential test compares, and where each file came from.
# Columns: role, source (commit:path, or the path in this repo), sha256 of the text with CR removed.
# The rolling dev pre-release (0.0.0-nightly.20260820.2696dd1, commit 2696dd1, core pin 3465659) is
# the only published build: no v* release was published, and no predecessor repo shipped this mod.
# No release ZIP or launcher manifest shipped or seeded a HeadTracking.ini: every player's file is
# the one Config::SaveDefaultIfMissing wrote on the first run, edited or not.
# The reader was frozen at 6efc755, whose src/core/config.cpp is 2696dd1's byte for byte. Every core
# source either reader compiles holds the same bytes at 3465659 and at 6efc755's pin (ba57f84).
# One startup change sits between the two builds: 71f6cda made ApplyConfigToSession set the
# downward lean limit from LimitY, where 2696dd1 left it at 0.20. Comparison 1 finds that

column2: the file 2696dd1's Config::SaveDefaultIfMissing writes (IniWriter, CRLF), tests/config_differential/data/first-run-dev-2696dd1.ini; the test checks the oracle still writes these bytes
